summary: Type-only: AssistantLayoutMode gains 'fullscreen', AssistantShellAction gains 'mode' and 'history', AssistantLayout gains required restoreMode. Exhaustive switches, Records keyed by these unions and hand-built AssistantLayout mocks stop compiling. Runtime is unchanged without modes.
howTo: Add 'fullscreen' cases (AssistantLayoutMode), 'mode' and 'history' cases (AssistantShellAction, e.g. in renderButton) and restoreMode to hand-built AssistantLayout values.
